episodes.synopsis: Sano's jumping well, and he seems happier. Nakatsu's still confused about Mizuki, but then a girl asks him out?!
episodes.title: Definitely Weird

episodes.synopsis: Even though Nakatsu is dating Komatsu, he can't stop thinking about Mizuki. Meanwhile, Mizuki starts karate...
episodes.title: Please Make Me Stronger!

episodes.synopsis: An unexpected visitor arrives before the school trip, turning Mizuki's daily life upside down.
episodes.title: How Did You Know?!

episodes.synopsis: Everyone is enjoying the trip to Hokkaido. But Sano is lost in thought and wanders off, so Mizuki follows him.
episodes.title: I'll Wait

episodes.synopsis: During her midnight bath, Mizuki runs into Sano. Shaken by this, she can't look him in the eyes the next day.
episodes.title: I Can't Not Think About It

episodes.synopsis: Julia's worried that someone might find out that Mizuki is a girl. But then Sano's words rock her to the core.
episodes.title: It's Fine, Right?

episodes.synopsis: The picture of Sano, Nakatsu, and Nanba goes viral with girls. A fashion photographer is also interested.
episodes.title: Because I Want to Stay by Your Side Forever

episodes.synopsis: Akiha talks the gang into doing a test shoot. He's a good photographer, but is he also Umeda's boyfriend?
episodes.title: Teacher's Boyfriend?

episodes.synopsis: The photos turned out great, but Sano's not interested in modeling. So Akiha tries to convince Mizuki.
episodes.title: Don't Look!!

episodes.synopsis: Someone sabotaged the shoot and destroyed the photos. So now they're doing a shoot on location.
episodes.title: Did You Do It?!

episodes.synopsis: The joint Christmas ball with St. Blossom is coming up, but Mizuki ends up having to learn the girl steps?
episodes.title: What Do You Want?

episodes.synopsis: Mizuki wants to dance with Sano, but Nakatsu jumps in and asks her to partner with him.
episodes.title: No Helping It
